# Make an Important Decision Before Every Option Can Be Explored

[← Amazon](../README.md) · [Every Amazon question](../../amazon.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/make-an-important-decision-before-every-option-can-be-explored)

---

Tell me about a situation where you had to make a significant choice quickly, without being able to consider all alternatives.
### Constraints & Assumptions
Draw from an actual experience and separate your own input from what the team did. This text gives the interview question, not a sample response; any example stories in the solution are made up.
### Clarifying Questions
What choice was required, by what deadline, and with what consequences? What information was critical? What alternatives or unknowns did you deliberately set aside?
### What a Strong Answer Covers
A contained decision-making approach, clear risk acknowledgment, evidence matching the stakes, communication, and a method to revisit or undo the decision.
### Follow-up Questions
Why would delaying have been worse? What could have led you to decide differently? Which aspect could be undone, and how did you keep track of it?
Overview:
Describe a decision made under time pressure by pointing out key evidence, acknowledged unknowns, reversible actions, communication with stakeholders, and how you verified results.
